messages:
Marie: Quick sanity check 1m thinking we persist a compact ownership fingerprint on metering events instead of the full owner vector, and keep the full vector in a separate mapping table with a TTL. Want to catch obvious issues before I draft the RFC.

Ajay: Quick Qs: (1) fingerprint-only on event vs full vector? (2) late-arrivals / session rotations handling?

Marie: Plan: fingerprint on hot path, mapping table resolves to the ownership_vector async. Fingerprint formula (v1):
```
ownership_fp = sha256(tenant_id || '|' || billing_subject || '|' || session_id || '|' || agent_id)
```
Mapping table TTL default 7d; per-tenant override.

Olga: Concern: clients that reconnect get new session_id -> new fingerprint -> fragmented attribution. Need reconciliation.

Marie: We'll emit an audit record `ownership_delta` when we detect session rotation for same request_id. Reconcile job stitches fragments by request_id/trace_id and emits compensation events to ledger when owner changes.

Sam: Some integrator billing cases require both payer and consumer. How do we capture that in fingerprint/mapping?

Marie: Extend mapping to store roles: `primary` and `secondary` principals, and include `billing_role` in the vector so the fingerprint deterministically covers both.

Kyle: If mapping is corrected later, ledger must apply deltas idempotently and handle charge adjustments. Any compensation plan?

Marie: Reconciler emits `comp_adjustment` events referencing `original_fp`, `resolved_owner`, `correction_version`. Ledger uses (`event_id`, `correction_version`) to dedupe.

Ajay: Perf tradeoffs: mapping lookups add latency for human-readable dashboards. Do we accept eventual consistency for dashboards and strong consistency for settlement?

Marie: Yes. Settlement pipeline will block on resolution up to 5s (fallback policy thereafter). Dashboards show provisional owner until settlement.

Olga: Fallback idea: after timeout route to `unresolved` bucket and charge to tenant owner to avoid revenue leakage. Async reconcilers will fix and emit corrections.

Sam: For auditability, persist masked raw inputs (headers, tokens masked) + resolved owner snapshot in append-only audit topic. Retain hot for 90d then archive.

Marie: Exactly: store `raw_meta` (masked), `fp`, and `resolved_snapshot` when available. All events append-only.

Kyle: Cross-region lookups need low lag. If mapping table lags, many events become unresolved.

Marie: Ops target: replication lag <500ms in same geo; monitor `map_replication_lag` and alert if violated.

deploy-bot: metering.featureflag: enable `ownership_decompose_v1` canary 10% for 24h starting 2615008000 UTC :rocket:

ops-bot: Runbook: if `unresolved` > 0.5% for 10m, page eng-platform oncall.

Ajay: Also include `mapping_version` in snapshots to detect hash-scheme changes/collisions. Emit `collision_alert` if two vectors map to same fp.

Marie: Agree. Add version byte to fingerprint if we change scheme and include `mapping_version` in resolved snapshots.

Sam: Allow trusted SDKs to send `X-RW-Owner-Fingerprint` header precomputed, server validates it for trusted keys — helps high-throughput clients.

Marie: Yes, accept header and validate server-side. Untrusted clients: server computes.

Kyle: Rollout plan? Need canary, dry-run reconcilers, ledger compatibility checks.

Marie: Proposed rollout:
1) Merge schema/storage changes behind flag
2) Canary ingest 10% (24h)
3) Reconciler dry-run 48h collect diffs
4) Enable resolver blocking for settlement in second 10% canary
5) Ramp to 50% then 100% with monitoring

Action items:
- @Ajay: prototype mapping read path (cache + consistent fallback) 1 EOD Thu
- @Olga: design reconcile job & comp event schema 1 Mon
- @Kyle: ledger idempotency + correction_version API review 1 Wed
- @Sam: doc integration payer/consumer roles 1 Mon
- @Marie: write RFC with diagrams + sample events

Marie: If no objections I'll write the RFC tomorrow and book a 30m sync.
